name: Content Model v1
purpose: Represent reusable learning activities independently from the engine and interface.
principles: Content is mapped to one primary Can-Do.
Every activity declares its evidence target.
Feedback is actionable and bilingual when appropriate.
Personal contexts increase relevance but do not reduce transfer.
Content can be reused by multiple activity types.

fields.canDoId: Primary Can-Do being practiced or assessed.
fields.activityType: Reference to an activity type from activity-model.json.
fields.title: Short learner-facing title.
fields.support: Optional hints, model, vocabulary or grammar support.
fields.expectedResponse: Optional response shape, key points or acceptance criteria.
fields.evidence: How the response will be evaluated.
fields.metadata: Tags, estimated duration and content version.

evidenceSchema.dimensions: Must use dimensions compatible with progress-model.json.
evidenceSchema.independent: Whether the learner completed the target without substantive support.
evidenceSchema.errors: Structured errors with priority, type, target and message.
evidenceSchema.contextId: Identifies the situation in which evidence was produced.

feedbackSchema.principle: Explain clearly in Spanish when needed, but keep practice and demonstration in English.
